rules.rationale: Base equation defining parenCodes on the empty IntSeq.
Structural recurrence defining parenCodes on a nonempty IntSeq.
Guarded defining case of nextBalance for the open-parenthesis code; its simplification attribute implements this definition.
Complementary guarded defining case of nextBalance for every non-open-parenthesis code; its simplification attribute implements this definition.
Base equation defining scanBalance on the empty sequence.
Structural recurrence defining scanBalance by consuming one character through nextBalance.
Guarded defining case of nextMinimum when the new balance is below the previous minimum.
Complementary guarded defining case of nextMinimum when the previous minimum is retained.
Base equation defining scanMinimum on the empty sequence.
Structural recurrence defining scanMinimum from the next balance and next minimum.
Base equation defining scanLast to preserve the prior loop-target value for an empty sequence.
Structural recurrence defining scanLast by advancing the loop-target value to the current character.
Equation defining the named goodParens predicate from final balance and minimum prefix balance.
Equation defining possibleMatch as goodness of either concatenation order.
Positive guarded defining case of matchAnswer, yielding the code sequence for Yes.
Complementary guarded defining case of matchAnswer, yielding the code sequence for No.
